name: AK11C - Indoor Formaldehyde Detector (HCHO, Temperature, Humidity), Electrochemical Sensor
highlights: Electrochemical Formaldehyde — An electrochemical cell, not a semiconductor element. It responds to formaldehyde specifically, holds its reading over months rather than hours, and is the sensor class used for post-renovation testing.
Built for the New-Home Window — Boards, adhesives and new furniture off-gas formaldehyde for months after installation. This is the single-purpose instrument for exactly that period.
Temperature and Humidity Alongside — Not decoration: formaldehyde release rises sharply with both, so the two readings explain why a level moved.
1200 mAh, 6–8 Hours — 200 g — the lightest unit in the AK11 family. USB-C, roughly three hours to full.
Shares the AK11 Shell — Same tooling, colour box and 50-per-carton spec as AK11T, AK11H and AK11P, so a mixed pallet ships as a single line item.
